title: AI in Agriculture: Revolutionizing Farming for a Sustainable Future
description: Artificial intelligence transforms agriculture with precision farming, crop monitoring, and predictive analytics, enhancing yields and sustainability.
short_description: A plain-English guide to AI in Agriculture, focused on practical use, trade-offs, and sharper questions.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: Readers who want a grounded, non-technical view of AI in Agriculture, including farm operators, ag-tech teams, sustainability readers, and policy-minded observers.
